title: yliveticker · Yahoo Finance
description: Live Yahoo Finance ticks from an east-to-west global watchlist are stored in InfluxDB 2 (ticker_data). SYNTH-* prices appear only in the explicit synthetic test feed.

options.content: Ticks are stored in **InfluxDB** · bucket `ticker_data`. **Unofficial Yahoo WebSocket feed: no availability, completeness or timeliness promises.** Charts run east to west: **Asia-Pacific → Europe/Middle East/Africa → Americas → Global**. Select symbols above; chart info bubbles contain country, currency and UTC regular hours. Table counters reset on collector restart; charts retain stored history. Configured silent symbols stay visible. `SYNTH-*` is opt-in testing only. [Quickstart and limitations](https://github.com/yahoofinancelive/yliveticker/blob/main/docker/README.md).

panels.title: Time since last tick
panels.description: Receipt age is time since any message arrived. Newest quote age uses the greatest Yahoo timestamp seen in this collector run; older snapshots never move it backward. Session belongs to that newest quote, not necessarily the last arriving message. Yahoo can send overnight quotes while regular markets are closed. All configured symbols appear, including never-seen symbols. Status is observational; regular hours are estimates, not proof of Yahoo support. Verified JPX cash-market holidays cover 2026 only; other calendars are not covered. A stale heartbeat means collector/storage status is unknown. Received/Written count messages since restart, not unique trades or the selected chart range. Charts retain data from previous runs. No availability promises.

from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "volume_available")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.id, set: ["FPH.NZ", "BHP.AX", "7203.T", "0700.HK", "D05.SI", "RELIANCE.NS", "EMAAR.AE", "NPN.JO", "SAP.DE", "HSBA.L", "GC=F", "AAPL", "NVDA", "SHOP.TO", "VALE3.SA", "BTC-USD", "EURUSD=X"]))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => symbolLabel(id: r.id) =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_order: symbolOrder(id: r.id), _value: symbolLabel(id: r.id) + "|" + sessionInfo(id: r.id)}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_order"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
